chunks: We never sent before you apostles who did not eat food and walk the market places. We make some of you the means of trying the others. So will you persevere? Your Lord is always watching.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the human nature of the Prophets and the purpose of trials in life?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the authenticity of the Prophets' mission by affirming their participation in daily human activities, thereby refuting Gnostic claims of their transcendence from material existence. It further contextualizes the concept of *fitnah* (trial) as a divine mechanism for spiritual testing, where patience (*sabr*) is the requisite virtue for believers navigating social and economic interactions.
